text_description: A runway look built around a loose, elongated short-sleeve collared shirt tunic in a patchwork striped textile, worn open at the neck over matching striped knee-length shorts visible beneath the hem. The garment has a relaxed, straight silhouette falling to mid-thigh, with a pointed collar, deep partial button placket, dropped easy shoulders, and short sleeves finished with contrasting green, red, and cream banded trim. The surface is dominated by irregular vertical stripes in deep red, navy, cream, tan, black, and muted yellow, arranged in mismatched panels; one sleeve and parts of the body show a more plaid-like check variation. Utility-style patch pockets sit high on the chest and lower on the front, each with light beige flap bands and small button details, while the hem is emphasized by broad horizontal border stripes in cream, mint green, red, and tan. The matching shorts continue the vertical striped pattern and extend just below the tunic hem, creating a layered shirt-and-shorts proportion. Styling includes oversized dark sunglasses, long earrings, layered necklaces at the open neckline, and a hand-carried tote or bag with black straps and a glimpse of striped fabric, giving the look a bold, resort-like, eclectic patchwork mood.
